hub.name: Markets
hub.title: Gold, silver, and stock arithmetic — cv.cm
hub.description: Convert troy ounces, the Hong Kong gold tael, the market tael, and the Taiwan tael. Compute company market cap, P/E, and dividend yield from numbers you type. No live quotes.
hub.lead: These pages convert weights and do arithmetic. They do not show a market price.
hub.disclaimer: cv.cm converts units and does arithmetic. This is not investment advice, not a broker, and not a quote service. Do not place an order from these pages.
hub.q1: Does this column show live prices?
hub.a1: No. Gold and silver convert weights you type. Stocks use a price and a share count you type.
hub.q2: Where is the troy ounce different from the unit tool?
hub.a2: A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams. The ounce in the unit tool is the avoirdupois ounce, about 28.35 grams.
hub.q3: What does company market cap use?
hub.a3: Price times shares outstanding. That is the company's share count, not the shares in your account.
hub.q4: Why is there no bitcoin page?
hub.a4: cv.cm does not publish virtual-currency prices.
hub.q5: Can I trade from these results?
hub.a5: No. The results are arithmetic. They are not an order and not a quote.

ui.priceHint: Leave this empty to convert weight only.
ui.invalid: Enter a weight that is zero or greater.
ui.note: This is arithmetic, not a buy or sell recommendation.
ui.stockInvalid: Enter a price and the other figures as zero or greater.

gold.name: Gold weight
gold.title: Gold troy ounce to grams — cv.cm
gold.description: Convert gold between grams, troy ounces, the Hong Kong gold tael (37.429 g), the market tael (50 g), and the Taiwan tael (37.5 g). The unit tool's ounce is the avoirdupois ounce.
gold.h1: Convert a gold troy ounce to grams
gold.lead: Type a weight. Add a US dollar price per troy ounce only if you already have one. This page does not look up a gold price.
gold.q1: Is a troy ounce the ounce in the unit tool?
gold.a1: No. A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams. The unit tool's oz is the avoirdupois ounce, about 28.35 grams.
gold.q2: How do the Hong Kong gold tael, the market tael, and the Taiwan tael differ?
gold.a2: The Hong Kong gold tael used here is 37.429 grams, the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society figure. The market tael is 50 grams. The Taiwan tael is 37.5 grams. Each name is written in full.
gold.q3: Why is there no gold price?
gold.a3: This page only uses numbers you type. It does not fetch or prefill a gold price.
gold.q4: What if the price box is empty?
gold.a4: You only see the five weights. After you type US dollars per troy ounce, the page also shows the price per gram and per tael.
gold.q5: Can I place an order from this?
gold.a5: No. This is a conversion, not investment advice and not a quote.

silver.name: Silver weight
silver.title: Silver troy ounce to grams — cv.cm
silver.description: Convert silver with the same troy ounce, Hong Kong gold tael, market tael, and Taiwan tael as the gold page. No silver price is prefilled.
silver.h1: Convert a silver troy ounce to grams
silver.lead: Silver weights use the same units as gold. Type a US dollar price per troy ounce only if you already have one.
silver.q1: Does silver use the troy ounce?
silver.a1: Yes. A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams, the same unit as on the gold page.
silver.a2: The Hong Kong gold tael. The market tael is 50 grams and the Taiwan tael is 37.5 grams.
silver.q3: Why is there no silver price?
silver.a3: This page does not fetch or prefill a silver price.
silver.q4: What if I leave the price empty?
silver.a4: Only the weights change. Prices appear after you type US dollars per troy ounce.
silver.a5: No. It is a conversion of numbers you type.

stocks.name: Stock arithmetic
stocks.title: Company market cap and P/E — cv.cm
stocks.description: Compute company market cap from a price and shares outstanding, P/E from annual earnings per share, and dividend yield from the annual dividend per share. No quotes.
stocks.h1: Calculate company market cap and P/E
stocks.lead: Type a price, shares outstanding, annual earnings per share, and the annual dividend per share. Shares outstanding is the company's share count, not the shares in your account.
stocks.q1: Which share count does market cap use?
stocks.a1: Company market cap is price times shares outstanding. Do not type the share count in your account.
stocks.q2: What if earnings per share are zero?
stocks.a2: P/E stays blank. The page does not show infinity.
stocks.q3: What if the price is zero?
stocks.a3: Dividend yield stays blank, because the divisor is zero.
stocks.q4: Does this page show a stock price?
stocks.a5: No. It is arithmetic. Loan payments and compound interest have their own pages.
